data.description:
## Problem
`reconcile_helpers._commit_binding_store_snapshot` is the last reconciler write that composes `git_adapter.add` + `git_adapter.commit` against the tickets tracker OUTSIDE the atomic locked commit+push transaction. Ticket 6454-d06e-7361-4e3d attempted the conversion and reverted it: the only offered seam, `rebar._store.push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch`, stages with `git add -A`, which sweeps in `.bridge_state/last-pass.json` — a per-pass timestamp the deliberate selective 5-file staging excludes. The tickets HEAD then advances on every idempotent pass and `tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py::test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head` goes RED (reproduced in CI on Gerrit 1821 ps1 and locally).

Ticket 638a-3746-e58a-4929's R3 composition gate therefore lands with a durable reasoned `# raw-git-ok:` marker on that site. This ticket removes the marker by removing the reason for it.

## Approach (one of)
1. Add an optional pathspec parameter to `commit_and_push_tickets_branch` so a caller can stage a subset under the shared write lock, keeping the exact 5-file set and the bug-1e08 per-file idempotency check.
2. Or a small write_lock-wrapped selective-commit path in the store seam (no push, matching today's no-push behavior).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `_commit_binding_store_snapshot` no longer calls `git_adapter.add`/`git_adapter.commit`; it goes through the shared locked seam.
- [ ] The committed file set is unchanged (the same 5 `.bridge_state` files, never `-A`).
- [ ] `test_unchanged_second_pass_preserves_binding_store_bytes_and_head` stays green.
- [ ] The `raw-git-ok` marker on `reconcile_helpers.py` is deleted and `scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py` still passes.
data.title: Give the tickets-branch commit seam a pathspec so the binding-store snapshot can leave raw git
